# Third-party YARA rules (YARA-Forge subset)

sap-AV ships a curated subset of public YARA rules for infostealers, cryptominers and hack tools (ROADMAP E2).
These are **rules only**; no malware samples are included or used. The files here are generated by `update.ps1`;
the selection and the sap-AV verdict / category / MITRE mapping are in `curated-rules.txt`.

## Source

| | |
|---|---|
| Project | YARA-Forge, https://github.com/YARAHQ/yara-forge (rule packages built from the public repositories listed below) |
| Release | `20261108` (YARA-Forge 0.9.1, package created 2026-11-08) |
| Asset | `yara-forge-rules-extended.zip` |
| URL | https://github.com/YARAHQ/yara-forge/releases/download/20261108/yara-forge-rules-extended.zip |
| Asset SHA-256 | `8b812dedcab15f7911c2e0c6382566e3248e8affddd3e7f425dd1761170cefbd` |
| Filters | approved license; YARA-Forge quality >= 70 and score >= 65; modules `pe`, `math`, `hash` only; compiles alone under YARA-X 1.22.0 with slow patterns/loops as errors and only benign compiler warnings |

Rules are never downloaded at runtime. To update: change `-Release` / `-Sha256` in `update.ps1` (compare the hash with the digest GitHub publishes for the asset), run it, review the diff, and run the tests.

## Licensing

Only rules under DRL 1.1, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 are committed (decided 2026-11-11).
A rule's own `license` meta decides; if it has none, its source repository's license applies (then `update.ps1` adds a `license` meta naming it).
Every vendored rule also gets `license_spdx`. GPL, non-commercial (NC), share-alike (CC BY-SA), missing and unknown licenses are excluded.
